patient_name.why: so your care team knows who they're looking after

age.why: so we can shape the journey correctly from the very start — and bring in a parent or guardian if you are under 18

guardian_name.q: Because you're under 18, a parent or guardian will be part of every step of this journey. What's their full name?
guardian_name.why: we never plan care for anyone under 18 without a guardian involved — they approve every decision alongside you

guardian_contact.q: And the best phone number or email to reach them?
guardian_contact.why: so your care team can include your guardian directly in every confirmation and consent step

procedure_interest.q: What would you like to improve or treat? You can choose more than one.
procedure_interest.why: so we can begin matching you with the right specialists — and check that everything you choose can be safely combined

destination_country.q: Do you have a destination in mind, or would you like a recommendation?
destination_country.why: so we can find doctors licensed in your destination

email.q: Where should I send what I'm finding for you?
email.why: so the doctors, prices, and plan I'm putting together reach your inbox — and you never lose your place

phone.q: A phone number, in case we need to reach you quickly?
phone.why: so your coordinator can reach you directly if anything needs your attention

doctor_selection.q: Based on your procedure and destination, here are your matched doctors.
doctor_selection.why: so you can choose who cares for you, or let your care team recommend the best match

gender.why: a detail your doctor uses to plan your procedure correctly

nationality.why: so we can check visa and travel requirements ahead of time

medical_conditions_other.q: Do you have any medical conditions your doctor should know about?
medical_conditions_other.why: so your doctor can prepare the safest possible plan for you

allergy_details.q: Any allergies — medications, foods, or otherwise?
allergy_details.why: so nothing is prescribed or served that could harm you

has_companion.q: Will someone be travelling with you?
has_companion.why: so we can plan for one traveller or more from the start

preferred_date.q: When would you like to travel?
preferred_date.why: so we can check your doctor's and destination's availability

duration_of_stay.q: How long can you stay for recovery?
duration_of_stay.why: so your recovery plan and accommodation match your schedule

clinical_boundary_acknowledged.q: One last thing — please confirm you understand Morales coordinates your care but doesn't diagnose or prescribe. Your doctor makes every clinical decision.
clinical_boundary_acknowledged.why: a clear boundary we hold with every patient, always

final_review.q: Here's everything I've gathered — take a look before I send it to your care team.
final_review.why: so nothing goes to your care team without your review
